test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 13 April 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Trendy
solution: The correct answer is '**Popular**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate synonym of the given word '**Trendy**' is '**Popular**'. • **Trendy**: of, in, or pertaining to the latest trend or style. (नवीनतम प्रवृत्ति या शैली से संबंधित, में या उससे संबंधित) • *Example: the **trendy** young generation...* • **Popular**: liked by many people or by most people in a group. (लोकप्रिय, अधिकतर लोगों को पसंद) • *Example: a **popular** holiday resort...* **Correct Answer:__** *Popular.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Foreign**: belonging to or connected with a country that is not your own. (स्‍वदेश से भिन्‍न देश का या उससे संबंधित; विदेशी) • **Common**: happening or found often or in many places; usual. (प्रायः या बहुत सारे स्‍थानों पर पाया जाने या होने वाला; सामान्‍य, आम) • **Familiar**: well known to you; often seen or heard and therefore easy to recognize. (सुपरिचित; जाना-पहचाना) 18b:Tcf2, The correct answer is '**Whale sharks are caught commercially in some places around the world**'.
